selection: all 28 category queries: Category P@10, then Hit@10, then smaller lexical fraction w_l/(w_d+w_l)
remaining_exact_ties: report co-winners; use family order only to display one representative, no extra trials
normalization: per query and leg over up to 50 report candidates; (score-min)/(max-min); constant-score leg maps to 0; absent report contributes 0
zero_weight: exclude zero-weight leg entirely; pure-leg endpoints preserve that leg's exact ranking and evidence
cache_policy: reuse complete Step 6 report candidates when available; existing top-ten-only cache preserved and verified against one full-depth recapture; sweep itself is pure reranking
layer2: Step 6 judged-only condensed protocol on runtime qrels; coverage beside each signal; never used for selection
boundary: report endpoint wins without extending grid
